prompt: I want to build a landing page for a SaaS product — show me 3 style directions to compare
expected: Triggers clarifying questions about design context/brand; produces design_canvas with 3 variations; avoids purple gradients/emoji/Inter AI slop; gives specific rationale for each variation's differentiating dimension
tests: workflow questions + variations logic + anti-AI-slop checklist + design_canvas usage

prompt: Help me create a 10-slide product pitch deck for an AI tool startup
expected: Start with deck_stage.js; verbally vocalize the design system (colour/typeface/layout rhythm) and confirm before proceeding; alternate section divider/content/data/quote layouts; font size ≥24px; 1-indexed labels
tests: Junior Designer reports first then executes + deck_stage usage + visual rhythm + scale spec

prompt: Make a 30-second HTML animation explaining how neural networks work
expected: Use animations.jsx Stage+Sprite; write timeline before writing components; entrances easeOut exits easeIn; tell the story in phases rather than stacking animations; text dwell ≥3 seconds
tests: animations workflow + correct easing + rhythm design + duration control

prompt: Create a Habit Tracker App prototype
expected: Ask user for overview tiled layout or flow demo (default to overview); use assets/ios_frame.jsx, do not hand-code Dynamic Island; Tracker is high-density type — each screen must have ≥3 information density elements (completion rate, streak count, trend curve, achievement badges etc., not decorative); at least 5-7 screens side-by-side (home/create habit/detail/stats/settings)
tests: overview/flow routing + ios_frame hard binding + information density typing (high-density) + multi-screen side-by-side

prompt: Create a Reading Notes App prototype
expected: Overview tiled layout as primary; ios_frame.jsx; reading notes leans content-display, information density requirement less extreme than Tracker, but notes list page still needs ≥3 information layers (book, quote, tag, progress); at least 4-6 screens (home bookshelf/note detail/annotation highlights/search/notebook management); prefer serif display fonts
tests: overview default + ios_frame + information hierarchy + content-first visual rhythm

prompt: Create a Running Log App prototype
expected: Overview tiled layout; ios_frame.jsx; running app is high-density type (map, pace curve, heart rate zones, per-km split data) — each screen ≥3 product-differentiating data elements; at least 5 screens (today's summary/live run data/route map/history/monthly stats); avoid AI slop (no purple gradients, no decorative icon stacking, but data-viz icons are allowed)
tests: overview + ios_frame + high-density data visualisation + map/chart mixed layout + slop boundary conditions
